# Phase 1 — what changed on the way into `spec/machine.json`

*Machine-json phase 1 ([B133](../../../docs/DECISIONS.md) *(the machine becomes one JSON)*, plan: [`machine-json.md`](../machine-json.md)). Generated by `report.py` after `assemble.py`; regenerate, don't edit.*

`spec/machine.json` is the old spec's six fixtures, the map and `meta.json` merged under one id per state, with the implementation laid over them wherever the two differ. Nothing reads it yet: phase 2 points the tests at it. This report lists every place it differs from the old spec. You never need to open the JSON.

## In numbers

| | Old spec | `machine.json` |
|---|---|---|
| States | 139 in the fixtures (one twice), 83 on the map, the code showing 111 | 139 |
| Ids per state | up to four (fixture, map, code, alias tables) | one |
| Edges | 125 on the map, 255 fixture transitions, 82 named by the core | 284 |
| Rules | prose, and two Rust functions in the enumeration test | 23 |
| Said-lines | 425 | 501, each with an id |

Every move the core made across all 248 of its tests (recorded by `record-moves.patch`, 745 distinct moves) is now an edge or falls under a rule: 293 on an edge, 409 under a rule, and 43 that neither covered became 29 new edges (28 ratified in B134, the rest `provisional`). The edges: 250 drawn by the map or the fixtures, 29 made by the core in a run, 5 named by the core's arms.

## Still yours to ratify

1. **The landing's demo** — [DEVIATIONS #29](https://github.com/bagrat/shroom/blob/main/docs/DECISIONS.md#deviations-from-the-spec). landing → live (“watch the demo”) is `provisional` until your demo recording exists; the block waits, hidden. Release-blocking, and only you can record it.

## Ratified by you on 2026-10-14 (B134)

Where adopting the implementation changed a ratified line or move. You said “ratify 1, 2, 3, 5, 6” after the walkthrough; each is now `ratified` in the JSON and cites B134.

1. **Restart asks first** — [DEVIATIONS #44](https://github.com/bagrat/shroom/blob/main/docs/DECISIONS.md#deviations-from-the-spec). A new state, `restart-confirm`: “Start over?” · “This replaces the 4:32 you've recorded so far.” · Back · [ Restart ]. The drawn edge paused → countdown (“Restart — count already running”, N24/N39) is gone; Restart now goes paused → restart-confirm → countdown, and Back returns to paused.
2. **The born invite's link is masked** — [DEVIATIONS #22](https://github.com/bagrat/shroom/blob/main/docs/DECISIONS.md#deviations-from-the-spec). `invite-born` (and `add-another-mac`): the pill shows “v.myshroom.workers.dev/join/” and the code stays hidden; [ Copy link ] is the only way to it, where N28 drew the full link.
3. **“For macOS 14 or newer, Apple silicon.”** — B7, B44, the copy table. `landing` and `join-landing`: the fill drops “and Intel”, since everything built is arm64-only.

5. **10 rules written from the build**, where the old spec had prose or nothing:

   - **a call answering proves the network is back** (`offline-answer`, ARCHITECTURE §3.3, B134) — A wizard call that was out when the network dropped answers after all: the face re-derives from its answer.
   - **an unclassified failure, and back** (`unexpected`, [DEVIATIONS #25](https://github.com/bagrat/shroom/blob/main/docs/DECISIONS.md#deviations-from-the-spec), B134) — The one face for a failure nothing else classifies, from any wizard face, and back when an answer clears it or Try again.
   - **Turn it back on** (`turn-back-on`, N36, B134) — Row six is live on every Mac: Turn it back on runs the chapter's screen step wherever recording-off shows.
   - **the Space tab re-probes every row** (`space-reprobe`, N42, B134) — Settings · Space re-probes every row on entry; the first broken row is current with Region 2's state beneath it, or every row ticks (the inspection).
   - **a stop's popover holds until dismissed or answered** (`stop-popover-holds`, N34, N39, N40, B134) — A stop's popover is the stop's own: it holds until dismissed or answered (back online, the page opened); the next door is config.
   - **Disconnect… or Leave…** (`exit-sheet`, N36, B134) — The Space tab's exit is there in every mood: Disconnect… (an owner-class Mac) or Leave… (a member) opens its sheet — from a banner's button too (a removed Mac, a member's).
   - **Back keeps the space** (`exit-sheet-back`, N36, law 9, B134) — Back, or Esc, closes the sheet; the Space tab re-probes where it was.
   - **Settings opens where it should** (`settings-door`, N36, N42, law 1, B134) — The gear opens Settings on General the first time, then the tab last used; Reconnect your space and Add a token here open the Space tab, which re-probes and lands on the row the facts derive.
   - **the tabs** (`settings-tabs`, N36, law 1, B134) — Clicking a tab is an entry: General, Space (which re-probes, law 1) and Members (owner-class only).
   - **an invite opens its window** (`invite-arrives`, N30, N31, [DEVIATIONS #2](https://github.com/bagrat/shroom/blob/main/docs/DECISIONS.md#deviations-from-the-spec), [DEVIATIONS #20](https://github.com/bagrat/shroom/blob/main/docs/DECISIONS.md#deviations-from-the-spec), B134) — An invite that arrives — the deep link, a paste, the installer's file, or one remembered at the tray click — opens the invite window at the face peek's answer derives: the welcome, waiting, a dead link's line, already here, or the switch's question.

The map's 13 ports are gone: each edge now goes to the state on the far side.

## Edges and rules

**Moves that hold for a group are rules** (your pick (b)). The tests will expand each into its moves. Every rule, with the moves of the recorded run it covers:

| Rule | Says | Moves | Cites |
|---|---|---|---|
| **offline, then back where the facts stand** | wizard-offline interposes on any network-bound step and resumes where the facts stand. | 26 | N18, N42 |
| **a call answering proves the network is back** | A wizard call that was out when the network dropped answers after all: the face re-derives from its answer. | 2 | ARCHITECTURE §3.3, B134 |
| **an unclassified failure, and back** | The one face for a failure nothing else classifies, from any wizard face, and back when an answer clears it or Try again. | 41 | [DEVIATIONS #25](https://github.com/bagrat/shroom/blob/main/docs/DECISIONS.md#deviations-from-the-spec), B134 |
| **✕ closes the window** | ✕ closes the window at any row — Later's twin: nothing is lost, and the next door re-derives it. | 68 | N19, N21 |
| **every paste meets the shape check, then verify** | Any new paste starts the token row over: the shape check first, then verify; the row's spinner while a paste is checked or saved (the Checking beat). | 5 | N14, ARCHITECTURE §3.7 |
| **the rows mark themselves from the facts** | An answer can tick several rows: the plan's rows mark themselves from the facts each answer brings (token → gates → bucket → page → name). | 11 | N13, law 1 |
| **the chapter's step follows the grants** | Row six's step is derived from the grants and the warm-up, never stored: a grant already given skips its step, one switched off steps back. | 6 | N17, law 1 |
| **Turn it back on** | Row six is live on every Mac: Turn it back on runs the chapter's screen step wherever recording-off shows. | 4 | N36, B134 |
| **the Space tab re-probes every row** | Settings · Space re-probes every row on entry; the first broken row is current with Region 2's state beneath it, or every row ticks (the inspection). | 67 | N42, B134 |
| **click-away or Esc closes it** | Any popover closes on click-away or Esc; nothing is lost, and the tray stands where the facts are. | 11 | law 9, N21 |
| **paused shows its cause** | The auto-pause faces are faces of paused, re-derived from the cause and the Mac's presence; the tray click on the pause bars opens the popover at its cause; a Mac away shows nothing until it's back. | 2 | N24, N39 |
| **Quit with uploads draining asks first** | Quit shroom — the right-click menu or the popover's — while uploads drain asks first, over whatever idle popover stands. | 2 | N21 |
| **the take finalizes itself** | Mid-take — a paused or asking take too — the screen grant revoked or the disk at its floor finalizes the take: the stop beat, then its own popover. | 9 | N39, [DEVIATIONS #6](https://github.com/bagrat/shroom/blob/main/docs/DECISIONS.md#deviations-from-the-spec) |
| **a stop's popover holds until dismissed or answered** | A stop's popover is the stop's own: it holds until dismissed or answered (back online, the page opened); the next door is config. | 9 | N34, N39, N40, B134 |
| **the tray click is the door** | The tray click is the door: idle → config, or the setup window at the row the facts derive (a Mac whose chapter isn't done opens at row six). | 5 | law 5, N21, [DEVIATIONS #5](https://github.com/bagrat/shroom/blob/main/docs/DECISIONS.md#deviations-from-the-spec) |
| **a relaunch re-derives where you were** | Every entry re-probes: a launch or a relaunch lands on derive(probes), never on a remembered step. | 14 | law 1 |
| **Disconnect… or Leave…** | The Space tab's exit is there in every mood: Disconnect… (an owner-class Mac) or Leave… (a member) opens its sheet — from a banner's button too (a removed Mac, a member's). | 29 | N36, B134 |
| **Back keeps the space** | Back, or Esc, closes the sheet; the Space tab re-probes where it was. | 4 | N36, law 9, B134 |
| **Settings opens where it should** | The gear opens Settings on General the first time, then the tab last used; Reconnect your space and Add a token here open the Space tab, which re-probes and lands on the row the facts derive. | 7 | N36, N42, law 1, B134 |
| **the tabs** | Clicking a tab is an entry: General, Space (which re-probes, law 1) and Members (owner-class only). | 5 | N36, law 1, B134 |
| **an invite opens its window** | An invite that arrives — the deep link, a paste, the installer's file, or one remembered at the tray click — opens the invite window at the face peek's answer derives: the welcome, waiting, a dead link's line, already here, or the switch's question. | 34 | N30, N31, [DEVIATIONS #2](https://github.com/bagrat/shroom/blob/main/docs/DECISIONS.md#deviations-from-the-spec), [DEVIATIONS #20](https://github.com/bagrat/shroom/blob/main/docs/DECISIONS.md#deviations-from-the-spec), B134 |
| **a face comes and goes with its cause** | Faces are render properties of their state: a state and its faces, and one state's faces, re-derive into one another as their causes come and go. | 18 | N18, law 1, N34 |
| **one banner at a time, the highest** | config's banner shows while its cause stands and clears by itself when it goes; a higher banner hides a lower one (one at a time). | 30 | N38, law 1 |

## Loose ends

- The deviations table skips #33–35 and #37: numbered, never written. Nothing in the JSON cites them.
- Fixture transitions whose target was prose: those naming a state now go there; the derived returns (“(derived — re-probe)”, a window reopened after an update, the app quitting) are the rules' (`relaunch`, `offline`, …).
- Each state's `board` (its screen on the canvas) is the probe's guess for now; phase 4 settles it.
- The map's 13 notes are kept as `notes`, with their text and the states they're about.

## How it was made

1. `record-moves.patch` makes every shroom-core test log each step (where each surface stood before and after, the event, the arm and the edge it named); `reduce-moves.py` folds the log to `moves.json`.
2. `assemble.py` merges the fixtures, the map and `meta.json` under `ids.py`'s one id per state, lays `overlay.py` over them (the code-only states, shipped copy under its rows, the copy table, the edges the build changed), adds the core's named edges, then holds every recorded move to the edges and `rules.py`; what nothing covers becomes a `provisional` edge.
3. `report.py` writes this.
